## Name: Feature request

**About: Propose a robot, software, or team workflow improvement**
<br>**Title: "[Feature]: "**
<br>**Labels: enhancement**<br> 

---

## What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe what is difficult, missing, or unreliable today. Include when it happens and who it affects.

## What would you like the robot or software to do?

Describe the desired result. Focus on the behavior or outcome; the team can decide how to implement it.

## Which area does this affect?

- [ ] Autonomous
- [ ] TeleOp or driver controls
- [ ] Robot hardware or configuration
- [ ] Vision or sensors
- [ ] Build, testing, or development workflow
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other / not sure

## How could the team evaluate the result?

Describe a simple way to tell whether the change works. For robot behavior, include a scenario or example if you can.

## Competition impact

- [ ] Needed for an upcoming event — event/date:
- [ ] Would improve reliability or performance
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Not sure

## Alternatives or trade-offs

Are there other approaches, constraints, or risks the team should consider?

## Supporting material

Add sketches, photos, match footage, logs, or links. Remove private information before posting.
